description: Session lifecycle hooks for NTT project memory persistence (Layer 4)

SessionStart.description: Restore memory context from claude-flow at session start

hooks.command: echo '[MEMORY_RESTORE] Call memory_search with namespace=ntt to restore project context. Key memories: project-identity, progress-completed-work, client-seatrium, client-toyota-australia, data-consolidated-le-apac. Also read docs/MEMORY.md for full context.'

echo '[MEMORY_SAVE] Session ending. Use memory_store with namespace=ntt to persist: (1) any new decisions made, (2) progress updates, (3) gotchas discovered, (4) new client info. Update docs/MEMORY.md if stable insights changed.'

PreCompact.description: Save context before compression discards it

hooks.command: echo '[MEMORY_COMPACT] Context compression imminent. Use memory_store with namespace=ntt to save any in-progress work context before it is lost.'

memory_namespaces.ntt: Project-specific memories (decisions, patterns, gotchas, progress, clients)

memory_types.decision: Why X was chosen over Y — prefix key with 'decision-'
memory_types.gotcha: Pitfalls and warnings — prefix key with 'gotcha-'
memory_types.progress: What is done / in-flight — prefix key with 'progress-'
memory_types.data: Data file descriptions — prefix key with 'data-'
